title: Hayden Panettiere died from accidental overdose of drugs, including fentanyl, coroner says - NBC News
description: “Heroes” and “Nashville” star Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled an accident caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, officials said Tuesday.
